name: sthan
description: Verify, parse, autocomplete, and geocode US addresses, and look up IP locations, with the sthan.io API.
long_description: Adds sthan.io's address tools to Claude. Ask in plain English, for example "Is 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC a real address?" or "Where is IP 8.8.8.8?". Needs a free sthan.io API key (no credit card) from https://sthan.io. All tools only read data.

api_key.title: sthan.io API key
api_key.description: Free at https://sthan.io (Dashboard > API Keys). No credit card needed.

tools.name: sthan_verify_address
tools.description: Verify that a US street address is real and deliverable; returns the standardized address, ZIP+4, and deliverability status.

tools.name: sthan_parse_address
tools.description: Split a freeform US address into structured fields (number, street, unit, city, state, ZIP).

tools.name: sthan_autocomplete_address
tools.description: Suggest complete US street addresses as the user types.

tools.name: sthan_autocomplete_city
tools.description: Suggest US cities (with state) as the user types.

tools.name: sthan_autocomplete_zipcode
tools.description: Suggest US ZIP codes as the user types.

tools.name: sthan_geocode
tools.description: Convert a US address to latitude and longitude.

tools.name: sthan_reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert latitude and longitude to the nearest US street address.

tools.name: sthan_ip_geolocation
tools.description: Look up the approximate location of an IPv4 or IPv6 address.
